title: Align login Gherkin with file-based token cache
description: Make behave login scenario pass with ~/.auritus/credentials file storage

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Merged PR #7: login tokens are file-only (~/.auritus/credentials). CI quality passed; Gherkin aligned. Keyring save path removed so load and save use the same store.

right_now_summary: Login now saves and loads tokens from the ~/.auritus/credentials file, with aligned Gherkin tests.
